---
title: "04_describe"
format: html
---

Library
```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("ggplot2")
library("purrr")
library("patchwork")
```

Load the clean and augmented data
```{r}
clean_data <- read_tsv(file = "../data/03_dat_aug.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

Identify numeric and categorical columns
```{r}
numeric_cols <- clean_data |> 
  select(where(is.numeric)) |> 
  names()

categorical_cols <- clean_data |> 
  select(where(is.character) | where(is.factor)) |> 
  names()
```

Histograms for numeric columns
```{r}
walk(numeric_cols, function(col) {
  clean_data |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[col]])) +
    geom_histogram(
      bins = 30,
      fill = "steelblue",
      color = "white"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", col),
      x = col,
      y = "Number of participants"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("../results/04_describe/", paste0("hist_", col, ".png")),
    width = 7,
    height = 5
  )
})
```


Bar charts for categorical columns
```{r}
walk(categorical_cols, function(col) {
  clean_data |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[col]])) +
    geom_bar(
      fill = "steelblue",
      color = "white"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", col),
      x = col,
      y = "Number of patients"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("../results/04_describe/", paste0("bar_", col, ".png")),
    width = 7,
    height = 5
  )
})
```

Combine all plots into one large figure
```{r}
plots <- numeric_cols |> 
  map(function(col) {
    ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_histogram(
        bins = 30,
        fill = "steelblue",
        color = "white"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = col,
        x = NULL,
        y = "Count"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  })

combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Distributions of numeric variables",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))
  )

combined_plot
```
